fix.title: {{component}} is down

steps: Check that the database container or service is running.
Check free disk space on the database host.
Restart the database, then wait for the next check (every 5 minutes).
Check that the file storage service is running and reachable from the app.
Check the storage credentials and the bucket name in the settings.
Restart the storage service, then wait for the next check.
Check that LiteLLM is running and answers on its health address.
Check the provider keys have not expired or run out of credit.
Restart the gateway, then run the test-ai job in GitLab to see which step fails.
Check that Docker is running on the machine that runs the app.
Run the test-ai job in GitLab to see which step fails.
If the agent image is missing, deploy again from the latest tag.
